signal: PingCAP launched TiDB X, a new distributed SQL architecture, with GenAI and agentic capabilities at SCaiLE Summit 2025.

email.body1:
Reece, saw PingCAP launched TiDB X and its GenAI and agentic capabilities at SCaiLE Summit.

A new architecture plus the AI-company demand surge usually means more in-market accounts than the NA team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for TiDB off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Reece, quick follow-up for TiDB.

You sell into AI companies scaling fast, so you know the inbound and intent can outrun a NA team quickly. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings NA needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Reece, last bit of proof for TiDB.

Memgraph, also in data infrastructure, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how TiDB's reply rate likely compares to peer data-infra firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Reece, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling NA pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A major launch like TiDB X is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your NA motion? I will tailor it to TiDB either way.
